direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, with aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions tied to real state; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main and move the three recovery chips into the jobs zone so stations, jobs and callouts never overlap.
Raise side-zone body copy to 16px/24 and strengthen the 120 versus 80 mismatch with a spanning DOES NOT MATCH callout anchored between the tracks.
Add living emerald material-flow pulses only on feasible routes, with state glow on RECEIVING HOLD and full reduced-motion fallback.
Separate connection readiness for provider identity from the investigation evidence task in the side zone, each with its own heading, status and control; do not merge their states.
Make CELL-MILL-2 read as stopped with denser silver cross-hatching, a clear cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, and remove any route through it.
Enlarge verified-findings metrics to 26px tabular figures and keep the empty side-zone space reserved rather than stretching narration.
Give each recovery option a persistent selected state with 2px emerald focus ring; selecting one opens one-click Approve followed by the Authorize this decision wall.
Align finish and cost columns on a shared tabular baseline at 16px minimum so the three tradeoffs scan in one glance.
Add a single 240ms route trace in the SVG when an option gains focus, then hold static for reduced distraction.
Keep the pending proposal visibly untracked until approval: dashed silver borders, PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on every task card, and no progress fill implying started work.
Tighten task-card progress bars so t3 does not show a full emerald bar before approval; use silver track only until tracking begins.
Add depth and a soft emerald glow to the active t1 card while keeping t2 and t3 flat silver in their reserved station zone.
Strengthen the preview state: CELL-MILL-2 preview uses silver cross-hatching, cross marker and PREVIEW · WILL GO OFFLINE text distinct from confirmed OFFLINE.
Make the 24h to 0h capacity preview a large cinematic SVG transition tied to real selection, frozen under prefers-reduced-motion.
Raise the machine selector and its consequence sentence to 16px/24 with a 36px minimum target.
Keep provider-identity readiness checks and the reinvestigation evidence task as separate side-zone blocks with independent status lines, so a ready connection never implies evidence is complete.
Collapse the empty Verified findings zone to a reserved placeholder with one status sentence, preserving layout stability without filler.
Restore feasible-route glow only through CELL-MILL-1 and keep the stopped cell hatched with no route, reinforcing the changed capacity at a glance.
Mirror the constrained Split option state between SVG chips and side zone: hatched silver, cross marker and the two-online-cells reason in both places.
Enlarge the invalidated-acceptance status in the action bar to 16px and pair it with an emerald review-required marker.
Add bidirectional highlighting so focusing a side-zone option lights its SVG route and job cards simultaneously.
Preserve the coexistence clearly: blocked prior tasks in a hatched silver group physically separate from the proposed replacements awaiting approval, with counts matching in scene and side zone.
Change CELL-MILL-2 label from replan wording to plain OFFLINE with cross marker in the station zone, keeping detail in the side zone.
Give Approve revised tasks the single emerald primary treatment with visible focus ring and 36px minimum height.
Enlarge the three proof stages to fill at least 70% of main as a cinematic chain with connecting emerald trace that advances only on real verification state.
Raise passphrase guidance and field text to 16px/24 and keep the one primary, Verify ledger, as the sole emerald fill in the viewport.
Convert the dashed locked stages to silver cross-hatch plus LOCKED text so locked, blocked and offline meanings stay visually distinct.
Fix contradictory machine states: departments labelled 5 offline cannot also read RUNNING · 5 machines; derive both lines from the same real counts per department.
Scale Assembly machines to match other departments so the cascade reads as one plant, and keep OFFLINE cubes silver hatched with cross markers at legible size.
Animate a single emerald recovery cascade across departments on trigger, with depth and glow on feasible machines only, fully static under prefers-reduced-motion.
Keep the official logo in the opening story at native aspect and full black, emerald and brushed-silver fidelity, and lift body copy contrast to dim silver on black at 16px minimum throughout.
Enlarge the cascade screenshot so every machine is judge-readable without zooming, with a caption tying it to failure then recovery in the stated presentation order.
Tighten the five-step sequence into a single scannable emerald-numbered rail so the pitch order lands in under ten seconds.
